loc_kitchen.desc: LOCATION (sunny clay kitchen counter of warm sand clay with cream cupboards below and a window with clouds and clay trees behind)

loc_heat_cutaway.desc: LOCATION (upright cream clay cutaway board on a sand tabletop: a warm peach clay layer on top of a silver-grey metal slab, three cream clay arrows pointing down from the peach into the metal)

loc_chart_board.desc: LOCATION (upright cream clay board on green clay ground: a very tall silver-grey bar on the left, a tiny wooden-brown stub on the right, no letters or numbers)

loc_wood_bench.desc: LOCATION (cozy workbench of warm wooden planks by a window, a chunky light-wood block on it and a small glowing cream lamp)

loc_blocks_table.desc: LOCATION (sky-blue clay table with a shiny silver-grey metal block on the LEFT and a light wooden block on the RIGHT, green hills and clouds behind)

prop_thermometer.desc: PROP chunky cream clay thermometer with a signal-red column and round red bulb, tick marks only (the only red thing in every scene)

prop_wood_spoon.desc: PROP light-brown wooden clay spoon with pressed wood grain

prop_ice_cube.desc: PROP pale blue-white glossy clay ice cube (repeat it for a second cube)
